put.description: Store the charity's own publishable + secret keys (and optional webhook signing secret). The secret key is validated against Stripe, then encrypted at rest. It is never returned.

delete.description: Deletes the stored Stripe keys. Donations are disabled until keys are configured again.

get.description: Retrieve a single prayer time entry by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the prayer time entry

put.description: Update an existing prayer time entry by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the prayer time entry to update

delete.description: Delete a prayer time entry by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the prayer time entry to delete

get.description: Retrieve a single event by its UUID.

put.description: Update event details with optional image replacement.

images.description: New Images to replace old ones

delete.description: Soft delete an event. Only events with 'cancelled' status can be deleted.

409.description: Conflict - Event status is not CANCELLED

get.description: Returns the list of all donation causes available for campaigns.

put.description: Updates an existing donation cause name and returns the updated list of causes.

post.description: Creates a new donation cause and returns the updated list of causes.

delete.description: Deletes a donation cause by name and returns the updated list of causes.

get.description: Returns details of a single campaign identified by its ID.

put.description: Updates an existing campaign with the provided details.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a campaign that is in draft status.

put.description: Change the password of the currently authenticated admin user.

get.description: Retrieve a single announcement by its UUID.

put.description: Update announcement details. Cannot change status from sent to another state.

delete.description: Delete an announcement. Only unsent announcements can be deleted.

post.description: Cancels the PaymentIntent for an unpaid donation — e.g. the donor closed the app or started over. No-op if already failed; rejected if the donation was already paid.
Creates a donation for the specified campaign and returns information required to complete the payment.

get.description: Retrieve current masjid settings including address, contact, services, facilities, and payment info

post.description: Update masjid details including name, about, address, contact, services, facilities, and capacity

get.description: Get prayer times with pagination and optional date range filter. Sorted by date ascending.

post.description: Create a new prayer time entry for a specific date.
Bulk create or update prayer times using upsert by date.

get.description: Returns all events (including drafts) for admin with optional filters and pagination. Sorted by event date descending.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (draft, published, cancelled, completed)

post.description: Create a new event with optional image uploads. Accepts multipart/form-data.
Send a push notification for a published event to all registered mobile devices.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all campaigns for administration.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates a new campaign with the provided details.
Get a new access token using the refresh token stored in HttpOnly cookie.
Invalidate the current refresh token and clear the refresh token cookie.
Authenticate an admin user with email and password. Returns a JWT access token in the response body and sets a refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie.

get.description: Returns all announcements with optional filters and pagination.

post.description: Send a push notification for a sent announcement to all registered devices.

400.description: Announcement is not in sent status

patch.description: Update the status for a specific event (e.g., draft to published). Cannot change from published back to draft.
Updates the status of a campaign (e.g., active, paused, completed).
Update the status for a specific announcement.

get.description: Fetch notification history for sent announcements and events.
Returns the charity's Stripe publishable key so the mobile app can initialise the Stripe SDK and present the Payment Sheet.
Returns prayer times for the current week (Monday to Sunday).
Returns prayer times for today with the next upcoming prayer information.

404.description: Prayer times not found for today

get.description: Returns prayer times for a given month and year. Defaults to current month/year if not provided.

get.summary: Get Prayer Times For A Specific Date
get.description: Returns prayer times for the given date (YYYY-MM-DD). The nextPrayer field is included only when the requested date is today.

404.description: Prayer times not found for the given date

get.description: Get masjid information for mobile app including name, address, contact, services, and facilities.
Returns all published events for members with optional filters and pagination.
Retrieve a single published event by its UUID.
Returns a donation's current status (pending / completed / failed) and details. The mobile app polls this after payment to confirm the donation was settled by the Stripe webhook.
Returns the list of donation causes available for member donations.
Returns a paginated list of active and paused campaigns available for member donations.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of active donations for the specified campaign.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.description: Returns all sent announcements for members with optional filters and pagination.
Retrieve a single sent announcement by its UUID.
Returns whether Stripe is configured, the publishable key, and the key mode. Never returns the secret key or webhook signing secret.
Returns a paginated summary of donations for the specified campaign.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.description: Get details of the currently authenticated admin user.

StripeKeysUpdateRequest.description: The charity's own standalone Stripe API keys

publishableKey.description: Stripe publishable key (public — sent to the mobile app)

secretKey.description: Stripe secret key (stored encrypted at rest; never returned)

webhookSecret.description: Webhook signing secret from the charity's Stripe dashboard (stored encrypted). Required for donation confirmation to work.

StripeSettingsResponse.description: Status of the charity's direct Stripe connection

connected.description: Whether a secret key is configured and donations can be taken

keyMode.description: 'test' or 'live', derived from the key prefix

webhookConfigured.description: Whether a webhook signing secret is configured

keysUpdatedAt.description: When the keys were last updated

DonationCauseUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating a donation cause

oldCause.description: Existing name of the cause to update

newCause.description: New name for the donation cause

UpdateAnnouncementRequest.description: Request object for updating an announcement

message.example: Updated: Maintenance work will begin at 10 AM.

status.description: Status of the announcement (draft, scheduled, sent)

DonationCreateRequest.description: Request body for making a donation to a campaign

DonationCauseCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a new donation cause

CampaignCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a new campaign

description.example: Providing food packages to families in need during Ramadan.

CreateAnnouncementRequest.description: Request object for creating a new announcement

message.example: Please note that the masjid will undergo light maintenance tomorrow...

status.description: Status of the announcement (draft, scheduled, sent)

CampaignUpdateStatusRequest.description: Request body for updating a campaign's status
